name: Mestron Holdings Berhad
overview: 2026年，Mestron Holdings Berhad 的 Renewable Energy 板块通过全资子公司 Mestron Energy 与 Trina Solar 的谅解备忘录继续推进合作，但双方同意不再签订单独的最终协议，后续业务将按采购订单等商业文件进行。此外，公司于2026年5月28日公告该谅解备忘录的季度更新将停止。其他业务板块在所提供的公告中未见具体动态。
overview_en: In 2026, Mestron Holdings Berhad's Renewable Energy segment continued its collaboration under a memorandum of understanding between wholly-owned subsidiary Mestron Energy and Trina Solar, but both parties agreed that no separate definitive agreement would be entered into, with business dealings to be carried out based on purchase orders and other commercial documents. The company also announced on 28 May 2026 that quarterly updates on the MOU would cease.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: Mestron Energy 与 Trina Solar 双方同意不再就项目合作签订单独的最终协议，谅解备忘录继续作为合作基础，业务按采购订单等商业文件进行，并停止季度更新。
actions.text_en: Mestron Energy and Trina Solar mutually agreed that no further definitive agreement will be entered into for the project collaboration;

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: Mestron Energy 与 Trina Solar 的谅解备忘录截至2026年2月27日没有重大进展。
actions.text_en: There has been no material development pertaining to the MOU between Mestron Energy and Trina Solar as of 27 February 2026.
